name: MATHVISTA
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate mathematical reasoning of foundation models in visual contexts, consisting of 6,141 examples derived from existing multimodal datasets and newly created datasets.
creator: Pan Lu, Hritik Bansal, Tony Xia, Jiacheng Liu, Chunyuan Li, Hannaneh Hajishirzi, Hao Cheng, Kai-Wei Chang, Michel Galley, Jianfeng Gao (UCLA, University of Washington, Microsoft Research)
citeAs: MATHVISTA: Evaluating Mathematical Reasoning of Foundation Models in Visual Contexts
rai:dataCollection: The dataset was collected by integrating challenges from diverse mathematical and visual tasks, including 28 existing multimodal datasets and 3 newly created datasets.
rai:dataCollectionType: Document analysis, Manual Human Curator, Secondary Data analysis
rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data consists of examples from existing multimodal datasets and newly created datasets.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Examples are annotated with metadata, including question type, answer type, task category, grade level, visual context, and required reasoning skills. Annotations were performed by graduate students in STEM fields.
rai:annotationsPerItem: Each example is annotated with metadata, including question type, answer type, task category, grade level, visual context, and required reasoning skills.
rai:dataLimitations: The dataset may have gaps in the representation of certain types of mathematical problems and visuals.
